blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI for Property & Casualty — from enterprise strategy to production models — ai that answers to the p&l applied to the property & casualty operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it. Both are decision factories — rate against exposure and catastrophe models, settle against policy language and fraud signals — and both reward carriers whose document and data machinery is industrialized.

items: Telematics and GLM pricing outrun validation and filing capacity; model risk documentation is rebuilt under exam.
FNOL, estimates, medical and police files arrive as documents; triage takes days and leakage hides in the queue.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems, LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (FNOL and claims triage, Estimate review and leakage control, Commercial risk surveying) on Achala Compass and Achala Forge and Achala Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — Rate filing regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Voice and avatar interfaces that resolve, not deflect — with emotion-aware escalation and full auditability.
